entities.name: LIMITED-SERVICE state
entities.description: A NAS state where the UE has limited service capabilities, allowing only emergency services and eCall functionality.

entities.name: Cell selection/reselection
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE in LIMITED-SERVICE state to select or reselect a suitable cell.

entities.name: Local de-registration
entities.description: Procedure where the UE may de-register locally and initiate an initial registration for emergency services.

entities.name: eCall inactivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed when configured for eCall only mode at expiry of timer T3444 or T3445.

entities.name: Timer T3444
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers the eCall inactivity procedure when configured for eCall only mode.

entities.name: Timer T3445
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers the eCall inactivity procedure when configured for eCall only mode.

entities.name: eCall only mode
entities.description: Configuration condition where the UE is set to operate only for eCall services as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102.

relations.description: In LIMITED-SERVICE state, the UE shall perform cell selection/reselection.
In LIMITED-SERVICE state, the UE may perform local de-registration and initiate initial registration for emergency services.
In LIMITED-SERVICE state, if configured for eCall only mode, the UE shall perform eCall inactivity procedure at timer expiry.
eCall inactivity procedure is triggered at expiry of timer T3444.
eCall inactivity procedure is triggered at expiry of timer T3445.
eCall inactivity procedure is performed only if the UE is configured for eCall only mode.
